description: This file defines character encoding conversion functions and tables for a specific set of SBCS code pages in a firmware project. It includes lookup tables for various code pages and functions to convert characters between Unicode and OEM code pages, as well as to uppercase characters.

methods.name: ff_convert
methods.description: Converts a character between Unicode and OEM code page based on specified direction.

methods.name: WCHAR ff_wtoupper(WCHAR chr)
methods.description: Converts a Unicode character to its uppercase equivalent.
